# results/dryrun/ — SYNTHETIC dry-run of the runner (NOT RESULTS)

Everything under this directory is **synthetic**. It exists to prove that the runner's
orchestration path produces a schema-valid run record, an oracle result, a digest manifest and
RUNLOG entries without touching the live stack. No value here may be cited, plotted, or moved
into `results/raw/`.

* `fixtures/<run_id>/` — synthetic run bundles generated by
  `experiments/fixtures/build_dryrun_fixture.py` (ground truth, source dump, produced manifest,
  clean sink dump, publication dump, attestation, manifest, `fixture.json` with
  `"synthetic": true`).
* `raw/run-records/` — `wxeo.run.v1` records produced by
  `python experiments/runner.py --dry-run ...`; each record's `validity.notes` begins with
  `DRY-RUN synthetic fixture`.
* `raw/oracle/` — oracle outputs computed from the synthetic bundles.
* `raw/artifacts/<run_id>/` — the curated-archive + `digest-manifest.json` demonstration.

Reproduce:

```powershell
python experiments/fixtures/build_dryrun_fixture.py --run-id pilot-m2-f0-1k-p3-r00
python experiments/runner.py --dry-run --fixture results/dryrun/fixtures/pilot-m2-f0-1k-p3-r00 `
    --stage pilot --limit 2 --results-dir results/dryrun
python experiments/validate_record.py results/dryrun/raw/run-records/*.json
```
